Paper accepted by Int. Journal of Heritage in the Digital Era

A paper on “Colonia 3D – Communication of Virtual 3D Reconstruction in Public Spaces” has been accepted by the International Journal of Heritage in the Digital Era (IJHDE) and will be published in vol. 1, no.1, 2012. This article has been jointly authored by Matthias Trapp, Amir Semmo, Rafael Pokorski, Claus-Daniel Herrmann, Jürgen Döllner, Michael Eichhorn and Michael Heinzelmann.
